name: Basedash
mood: midnight data terminal with frosted type
summary: A pure-black data-product style with white pill CTAs, tight Inter UI typography, a restrained serif display voice, and sparse violet plus mint data accents.

typography.displayFallback: Cormorant Garamond, EB Garamond, PT Serif
typography.quoteFallback: Source Serif Pro Light, Lora, Palatino

dos: Use white filled buttons for primary actions.
Reserve violet and mint for data, focus, and state.
Use serif display type only for major headings.
Let product screenshots and dashboard mockups provide the visual drama.
Keep dark surfaces almost flat and minimally bordered.
donts: Do not make violet the primary CTA color.
Do not use lifestyle photography or decorative illustrations.
Do not add full-background neon gradients.
Do not overuse the display serif in functional UI.
Do not use heavy shadows on dark cards.
